danced_span.start_why: camera 01 starts with the couple's walk-on: Carlos with the hostess (0-1.5 s), alone across the floor (1.5-3.5 s, the first skips), Aline steps in from the right at 3.6 s and they are hand in hand at 4.6 s; only camera 01 sees 3.6-14.8 s (camera 02 starts at 14.82 s, mid-dance)
danced_span.end_why: the last figure and the bow: camera 02 shows the arms-out finish at 182.0 s (183.0 s the bow, they hug and walk off from 184 s) = 196.8-198.0 s on the reference clock; camera 01 cuts to a zoom-out at 196.95 s
